intent: What is the most common bond type?
description: most common bond type refers MAX(COUNT(bond_type))
source_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

intent: In the non-carcinogenic molecules, how many contain chlorine atoms?
description: non-carcinogenic molecules refers to label = '-'; chlorine atoms refers to element = 'cl'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T1.label = '-'

intent: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
description: single-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '-' ; average number of oxygen atom = AVG(element = 'o')
source_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

intent: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
description: carcinogenic molecules refers to label = '+'; single-bonded refers to bond_type = '-'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '-'), COUNT(atom_id))
source_sql: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

intent: In the molecule containing sodium atoms, how many are non-carcinogenic?
description: non-carcinogenic refers to label = '-'; sodium atoms refers to element = 'na'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'na' AND T2.label = '-'

intent: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
description: triple-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '#'; carcinogenic refers to label = '+'
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

intent: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
description: carbon refers to element = 'c'; double-bond molecules refers to bond_type = '='; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'c'), COUNT(atom_id))
source_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

intent: How many triple type bonds are there?
description: triple type bonds refers to bond_type = '#'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '#'

intent: In how many atoms is there no bromine?
description: atoms with no bromine refers to element ! = 'br'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T.atom_id) FROM atom AS T WHERE T.element <> 'br'

intent: Of the first 100 molecules in number order, how many are carcinogenic?
description: first 100 molecules in number order refers to molecule_id between 'TR000' and 'TR099'; label = '+' means molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' AND T.label = '+'

intent: Identify by their ID the molecules in which there is carbon.
description: carbon refers to element = 'c';
source_sql: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM atom AS T WHERE T.element = 'c'

intent: What elements are in the TR004_8_9 bond atoms?
description: TR004_8_9 bond atoms refers to bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

intent: What elements are in a double type bond?
description: double type bond refers to bond_type = '=';
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

intent: Which type of label is the most numerous in atoms with hydrogen?
description: with hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label most numerous in atoms refers to MAX(COUNT(label));
source_sql: SELECT T.label FROM ( SELECT T2.label, COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'h' GROUP BY T2.label ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) t

intent: Chlorine is in what type of bond?
description: type of bond refers to bond_type; chlorine refers to element = 'cl'
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'cl'

intent: What atoms are connected in single type bonds?
description: single type bond refers to bond_type = '-';
source_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

intent: Indicate which atoms are connected in non-carcinogenic type molecules.
description: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.label = '-'

intent: Which element is the least numerous in non-carcinogenic molecules?
description: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; least numerous refers to MIN(COUNT(element));
source_sql: SELECT T.element FROM (SELECT T1.element, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) ASC LIMIT 1) t

intent: What type of bond is there between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20?
description: type of bond refers to bond_type; between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20 refers to atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR another way around
source_sql: SELECT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20'

intent: What type of label is not on molecules with atoms with tin?
description: tin refers to element ! = 'sn'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element != 'sn'

intent: How many atoms with iodine and with sulfur type elements are there in single bond molecules?
description: with iodine element refer to element = 'i'; with sulfur element refers to element = 's'; single type bond refers to bond_type = '-'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'i' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'

intent: Identify all connected atoms with a triple bond.
description: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';
source_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

intent: Identify all the atoms that are connected to the atoms of the TR181 molecule.
description: TR181 molecule refers to molecule_id = 'TR181'
source_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR181'

intent: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; contain fluorine refers to element = 'f'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'f') * 100, COUNT(molecule_id)) where label = '+'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;
source_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

intent: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) as percent where label = '+'
source_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'

intent: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.
description: TR000 is the molecule id;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element LIMIT 3

intent: What are the atoms that are bonded in the molecule TR001 with the bond ID of TR001_2_6?
description: TR001 is the molecule id; TR001_2_6 is the bond id
source_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(T.bond_id, 1, 7) AS atom_id1 , T.molecule_id || SUBSTR(T.bond_id, 8, 2) AS atom_id2 FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR001' AND T.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'

intent: What is the difference between the number of molecules that are carcinogenic and those that are not?
description: label = '+' means molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; difference = SUBTRACT(SUM(label = '+'), SUM(label = '-'))
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T.label = '+' THEN T.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN T.label = '-' THEN T.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS diff_car_notcar FROM molecule t

intent: What are the atom IDs of the bond TR000_2_5?
description: TR000_2_5 is the bond id
source_sql: SELECT T.atom_id FROM connected AS T WHERE T.bond_id = 'TR000_2_5'

intent: What are the bond IDs that have the same atom ID 2 of TR000_2?
description: TR000_2 is the atom id; atom ID 2 refers to atom_id2
source_sql: SELECT T.bond_id FROM connected AS T WHERE T.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'

intent: Please list top five molecules that have double bonds in alphabetical order.
description: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = ';
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.molecule_id FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' ORDER BY T.molecule_id LIMIT 5

intent: What is the percentage of double bonds in the molecule TR008? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
description: double bond refers to bond_type = '='; TR008 is the molecule id; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '='), COUNT(bond_id)) as percent where molecule_id = 'TR008'
source_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.bond_type = '=' THEN T.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR008'

intent: What is the percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with three decimal places.
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+'), COUNT(molecule_id)) as percent
source_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.label = '+' THEN T.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.molecule_id),3) FROM molecule t

intent: How much of the hydrogen in molecule TR206 is accounted for? Please provide your answer as a percentage with four decimal places.
description: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; TR206 is the molecule id; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'h'), COUNT(atom_id)) as percent where molecule_id = 'TR206'
source_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'h' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.atom_id),4) FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR206'

intent: What is the type of bond that molecule TR000 has when involved in any bonds?
description: type of bond refers to bond_type; TR000 is the molecule id
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.bond_type FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000'

intent: What are the elements of the toxicology and label of molecule TR060?
description: TR060 is the molecule id;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR060'

intent: Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?
description: TR010 is the molecule id; majority of the bond found refers to MAX(COUNT(bond_type));
source_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT T1.bond_type, COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1  WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY T1.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T1.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

intent: Please list top three molecules that have single bonds between two atoms and are not carcinogenic in alphabetical order.
description: label = '-' means molecules are not carcinogenic; single type bond refers to bond_type = '-'; list top three molecules refers to return molecule_id and order by molecule_id;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.label = '-' ORDER BY T2.molecule_id LIMIT 3

intent: Please list top two bonds that happened with the molecule TR006 in alphabetical order.
description: TR006 is the molecule id
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY T2.bond_id LIMIT 2

intent: How many bonds which involved atom 12 does molecule TR009 have?
description: TR009 is the molecule id;  involved atom 12 refers to atom_id = 'TR009_12' or atom_id2 = 'TR009_12'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND T2.atom_id = T1.molecule_id || '_1' AND T2.atom_id2 = T1.molecule_id || '_2'

intent: How many molecules are carcinogenic and have the bromine element?
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; have bromine element refers to element = 'br'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'br'

intent: What are the bond type and the atoms of the bond ID of TR001_6_9?
description: atoms refer to atom_id or atom_id2
source_sql: SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

intent: Which molecule does the atom TR001_10 belong to? Please state whether this molecule is carcinogenic or not.
description: TR001_10 is the atom id; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT T2.molecule_id , IIF(T2.label = '+', 'YES', 'NO') AS flag_carcinogenic FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR001_10'

intent: How many molecules have a triple bond type?
description: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '#'

intent: How many connections does the atom 19 have?
description: connections refers to bond_id; atom 19 refers to atom_id like 'TR%_19';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM connected AS T WHERE SUBSTR(T.atom_id, -2) = '19'

intent: List all the elements of the toxicology of the molecule "TR004".
description: TR004 is the molecule id;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR004'

intent: How many of the molecules are not carcinogenic?
description: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T WHERE T.label = '-'

intent: Among all the atoms from 21 to 25, list all the molecules that are carcinogenic.
description: atoms from 21 to 25 refers to SUBSTR(atom_id, 7, 2) between '21' and '25'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.label = '+'

intent: What are the bonds that have phosphorus and nitrogen as their atom elements?
description: have phosphorus as atom elements refers to element = 'p'; have nitrogen as atom elements refers to element = 'n'
source_sql: SELECT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id IN ( SELECT T3.bond_id FROM connected AS T3 INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id WHERE T4.element = 'p' ) AND T1.element = 'n'

intent: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
description: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

intent: What is the average number of bonds the atoms with the element iodine have?
description: atoms with the element iodine refers to element = 'i'; average = DIVIDE(COUND(bond_id), COUNT(atom_id)) where element = 'i'
source_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'i'

intent: List the bond type and the bond ID of the atom 45.
description: bond ID of atom 45 refers to SUBSTR(atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45; double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';
source_sql: SELECT T1.bond_type, T1.bond_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.atom_id, 7, 2) = '45'

intent: List all the elements of atoms that can not bond with any other atoms.
description: atoms cannot bond with other atoms means atom_id NOT in connected table;
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.element NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id )

intent: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
description: TR041 is the molecule id; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';
source_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T3.molecule_id = 'TR041'

intent: What are the elements of the atoms of TR144_8_19?
description: TR144_8_19 is the bond id;
source_sql: SELECT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'

intent: Of all the carcinogenic molecules, which one has the most double bonds?
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; double bond refers to bond_type = ' = ';
source_sql: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.label = '+' AND T1.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

intent: What is the least common element of all carcinogenic molecules?
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT T.element FROM ( SELECT T2.element, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+' GROUP BY T2.element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) LIMIT 1 ) t

intent: What are the atoms that can bond with the atom that has the element lead?
description: atom that has the element lead refers to atom_id where element = 'pb'
source_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

intent: List the elements of all the triple bonds.
description: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.element FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

intent: What percentage of bonds have the most common combination of atoms' elements?
description: DIVIDE(COUNT(bond_id), COUNT(atom_id where MAX(COUNT(atom_id)) ))
source_sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id GROUP BY T2.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM connected )

intent: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
description: single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) where bond_type = '-'
source_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

intent: Calculate the total atoms consisting of the element carbon and hydrogen.
description: consisting of element carbon and hydrogen refers to element in('c', 'h')
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.atom_id) FROM atom AS T WHERE T.element = 'c' OR T.element = 'h'

intent: List down atom id2 for atoms with element sulfur.
description: element sulfur refers to element = 's'
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 's'

intent: What are the bond type for atoms with element Tin?
description: element Tin refers to element = 'sn'; double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.bond_type FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 'sn'

intent: How many elements are there for single bond molecules?
description: single bond refers to bond_type = '-';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T.element) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id, T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-' ) AS T

intent: Calculate the total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing the element phosphorus or bromine.
description: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; phosphorus refers to element = 'p'; bromine refers to element = 'br'
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T1.element IN ('p', 'br')

intent: Write down bond id for molecules that are carcinogenic.
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

intent: Among the single bond molecule id, which molecules are not carcinogenic?
description: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; single bond refers to bond_type = '-';
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-' AND T1.bond_type = '-'

intent: What is the composition of element chlorine in percentage among the single bond molecules?
description: element chlorine refers to element = 'cl'; single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'cl'), COUNT(atom_id)) as percent where bond_type = '-'
source_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'cl' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.atom_id) FROM ( SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-' ) AS T

intent: What are the labels for TR000, TR001 and TR002?
description: TR000, TR001 and TR002 are molecule id; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT molecule_id, T.label FROM molecule AS T WHERE T.molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

intent: List down the molecule id for non carcinogenic molecules.
description: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T WHERE T.label = '-'

intent: Calculate the total carcinogenic molecules for molecule id from TR000 to TR030.
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T WHERE T.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030' AND T.label = '+'

intent: List down the bond type for molecules from molecule id TR000 to TR050.
description: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#';

intent: What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio with its label.
description: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; ratio = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'h'), count(element)) where molecule_id = 'TR006' ; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: WITH SubQuery AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id, T1.element, T1.molecule_id, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR006') SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / (CASE WHEN COUNT(atom_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(atom_id) END) AS ratio, label FROM SubQuery GROUP BY label

intent: What is the element with the atom ID of TR004_7 in molecule that is not carcinogenic?
description: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; element = 'cl' means Chlorine; element = 'c' means Carbon; element = 'h' means Hydrogen; element = 'o' means Oxygen, element = 's' means Sulfur; element = 'n' means Nitrogen, element = 'p' means Phosphorus, element = 'na' means Sodium, element = 'br' means Bromine, element = 'f' means Fluorine; element = 'i' means Iodine; element = 'sn' means Tin; element = 'pb' means Lead; element = 'te' means Tellurium; element = 'ca' means Calcium
source_sql: SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND T2.label = '-'

intent: What is the total number of molecules with double bonded oxygen?
description: oxygen refers to element = 'o'; double bond refers to bond_type = ' = ';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '=' AND T1.element = 'o'

intent: in molecules with triple bonds, how many of them are not carcinogenic?
description: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T1.label = '-'

intent: List the element and bond type included in the molecule with molecule ID of TR002.
description: TR002 is the molecule id
source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.bond_type FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002'

intent: What is the atom ID of double bonded carbon in TR012 molecule?
description: carbon refers to element = 'c'; double bond refers to bond_type = ' = ';
source_sql: SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR012' AND T3.bond_type = '=' AND T1.element = 'c'

intent: List the atom ID of the carcinogenic molecule that contains oxygen?
description: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; oxygen refers to element = 'o'
source_sql: SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T2.label = '+'
